title: Vesper and the Bell
author: Dominic Ishikawa
blurb: Casper Oyelaran, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
